data.headline: Intuit QuickBooks Report Reveals Small Businesses Project a Third of Yearly Revenue from Holiday Sales as Consumer Spending Expected to Decrease by 34%
data.summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., October 15, 2024--A new Intuit QuickBooks data report revealed that rising costs and continued inflationary pressures are causing a pull back on spending, as consumers are expected to spend $85 billion less this holiday season, a 34% year-over-year downturn. These findings and more are highlighted in the annual QuickBooks Holiday Shopping Report, based on a recent survey of U.S. consumers and small businesses commissioned by Intuit Inc.
